summary: R4 well-scoped closure of GATE-2 brownfield-descope risk. Operator authorization documented; both flags correctly implemented; tests cover 4 named + 3 guards; STATUS.md chain captures all five required fields. 9 specific gaps. Most operationally significant: G-MAJ-01 (DISPATCH-NOTE AC line 95 missing flag; operator following AC checklist would do destructive default); G-MAJ-02 (ADOPT-001 §12.7.3 verification block hard-codes single-context expected output, wrong for brownfield); G-MAJ-03 (CT cascade-start notification not updated). D-035 doesn't need sibling D-NNN (hardening, not new doctrine). WP-SCP-024 §6 preconditions don't need 4th entry (implementation property, not gated precondition). Cardinal rule 1 upheld.

findings.claim: DISPATCH-NOTE Acceptance Criteria line 95 shows greenfield invocation without --preserve-existing-contexts; operator following AC checklist would execute destructive default that R4 was designed to prevent.
findings.impact: Operator executing Phase 1 via AC checklist as recipe would skip flag, silently removing PIM's 4 prior CI gates.
findings.mitigation: Update line 95 to include --preserve-existing-contexts; AC must match Step 3 runbook exactly.

findings.claim: ADOPT-001 §12.7.3 verify-gate-live block hard-codes expected contexts as single-element ["policy-check / scp/policy-check"]; brownfield adopters (every WP-SCP-024 cohort adopter) see 5+ contexts and would falsely conclude misconfiguration.
findings.impact: Brownfield adopter following §12.7.3 verification falsely believes gate failed; audit tools produce false negatives.
findings.mitigation: Add brownfield variant to verification block documenting expected prior_count + 1 contexts including canonical.

findings.claim: CT cascade-start notification (SCP-ESTATE-CASCADE-START-2026-05-15.md) was authored pre-R4, contains no reference to brownfield-adopter pattern / preserve flag / skip flag; primary discovery path for CT-side operators.
findings.impact: CT (024D) + recommender + mapp-doc-agent + shopify-app operators reading the notification as onboarding guide would miss R4 flags; re-discovery problem the notification should prevent.
findings.mitigation: Amend notification with dated erratum citing R4 brownfield flags + pointer to ADOPT-001 §12.7.3 brownfield. CROSS-REPO write — operator-mediated per Pattern 4.

findings.claim: branch-protection-log.md Format section not updated with two new R4 structured fields
findings.impact: Audit tooling per Format-section schema would not know to grep preserve-existing-contexts: true; next-session operator's first log entry compliant only via script-output reading, not log schema.
findings.mitigation: Add two lines to Format section documenting preserve-existing-contexts + skip-required-signatures fields.

findings.claim: ADOPT-001 §12.7.3 doesn't provide FUP row template text; adopters told to file 'FUP-<ADOPTER>-COMMIT-SIGNING' without template or example
findings.impact: Adopters may skip filing FUP (no template) or file incompatible format; signing gap persists with no tracking. Low risk for PIM, relevant for 024D-024F.
findings.mitigation: Add minimal template block: example STATUS.md/DISPATCH-NOTE row with close-condition wording.

findings.claim: ADOPT-001 §12.7.3 brownfield section not cross-linked from §6 Pre-Onboarding Decisions; adopter scanning §6 first doesn't encounter brownfield/greenfield distinction until §12.7.3
findings.impact: Next-session operator running 024D risks missing flag for current all-brownfield cohort.
findings.mitigation: Add row to §6 table: Branch-protection posture decision pointing to §12.7.3 brownfield subsection.

findings.claim: ADOPT-001 §12.7.3 doesn't include concrete BEFORE/AFTER JSON worked example
findings.impact: Adopters may need --plan to understand merge shape (low-risk).
Future refactor could silently diverge; no functional risk.
findings.mitigation: Extract shared assertion to helper OR document intentional duplication in comment.

findings.claim: ADOPT-001 §12.7.3 brownfield section names WP-SCP-024 cohort inline; staleness risk if cohort changes
findings.impact: Drift risk; no current accuracy problem.
findings.mitigation: Replace inline list with pointer to plan-doc §6 canonical source.
